definitions.explanation: Assets or property pledged as security for a loan, which can be seized if the borrower fails to repay.
Something that serves as a guarantee or assurance that something will happen.

examples.japanese: {担保|たんぽ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{担保|たんぽ}⟦なし→なし：03779_nashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
